profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hewlett Packard Enterprise
profile.summary:
I am dedicated to delivering quality software solutions. I'm proficient at programming in golang, Python, JavaScript, React, C#, and Java. I am familiar with WPF, HTML, XML, C/C++, and JSON. I am comfortable with git and subversion (svn) for source control.  I am trained in Agile and scrum development.

GitHub: https://github.com/tfbirk
CodePen: https://codepen.io/tfbrown
Repl.it: https://repl.it/@tfbirk/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead a team and develop software solution to gather, store, and report product information, including carbon emissions using golang and SQL. CI/CD using GitHub Actions and docker. Write unit and integration tests. Use RESTful APIs. 
- Develop application software for server management using Python, JavaScript, React, and HTML/CSS
- Create GUI and CLI tools
- Create and use RESTful APIs to communicate with remote systems
- Served as scrum master for Agile software development of a global team
- Contribute to documentation ranging from specifications to customer-facing user guides
- Write unit and functional tests to ensure code quality

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop application software using C# and WPF
- Communicate with technical leads and marketing to define product requirements and specifications
- Support client team requirements with usable interfaces and classes
- Collaborate with international colleagues
- Lead Agile/Scrum development using Rally software

positions.title: Applications Engineer (Engineering Leadership Program)
positions.description:
- Provided technical support for software and hardware, specifically LabVIEW, TestStand, data acquisition cards, device  driver software, and instrument control products.
- Demonstrated functionality and benefits of NI software and hardware to potential customers.
- Created and monitored online technical content, namely KnowledgeBase articles and Discussion Forums.
- Enabled sales and repeat business by providing customers positive experiences with NI products.
- Participated in over 200 hours of training on NI software and hardware.

positions.title: NSF REU BioNetworks Summer Intern
positions.description: I developed a metric for actin fiber alignment in cell images using image processing tools in Matlab. I also did human cell culturing, maintenance, and imaging. The goal of the research is study human cell behavior through computer modeling and in vitro assays to research the regeneration of blood vessels. I will soon be published as a research contributor in ACS Nano.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
